verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM's own feature docs claim stage-based forecasting with weighted deal values, which covers pipeline value and implies stage probabilities, and deal values appear on every card. Nothing in the evidence ties the forecast to expected close dates or time periods, and the probability mechanics are only implied by 'weighted'. Missing for 10: forecasting by close date or period, documented configuration of stage probabilities, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the forecast feature.

support.subject: As a founder, I can forecast revenue from pipeline value, stage probabilities, and close dates

citations.quote: Forecast by stage with weighted deal values
with deal value and next step visible on every card
